Attended Facetime meeting for 30 minutes on 14032023

https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/.github/blob/main/assets/20230314%20-%20minutes%20from%20operations%20meeting%20
Each Sub-DAO should have its own legal entity to prevent issue with one sub-DAO from spilling over to affect the other DAOs
10 - 25% of revenue generated within the Sub-DAO should go to the parent DAO's vault. This leaves enough budget for the sub-DAOs to operate
Sub-DAO project allocation needs should be approved by parent DAO in terms of governance tokens allocation as well as USDT allocation
Governance recommended guidelines provided by the parent DAO to the sub DAO should be at a medium to high level.
Sub-DAOs should strive to stay within the constitution of the parent DAO
Reiterated the need for a rule book that DAO members can reference
Since each sub-DAO will have its own use cases its catering for they will need the flexibility to do so
Funding criteria of Sub-DAO should come accompanied with high level KPIs and high level strategies that the sub-DAO agrees to execute upon
Founder title should stay. Decentralization is based on how governance is structured and not whether there exist a founder within the DAO

Project structure should consist of 
 - project
  - background
  - purposes
  - requirements
  - KPIs to meet

Should paid roles be introduced within the scopes of projects, members applying for the roles should be subjected to an initial voluntary period 

  - to decipher if it is just a cash grab
  - eventually pay the bills

For defined roles within the scope of a project, the following needs to be provided 

  - allocate budget
  - indicate timeline work needs to be done
  - the details of the work to be done
Reiterated Gary's point. Alot of initial motiviation is about gaining recognition instead of just money

narrative.text: Aléksa Mil contributed to Agroverse, Cypher Defense, and TrueSight DAO from October 2020 to November 2023, with contributions primarily in strategy development and legal work. Aléksa provided a full-scale strategy and rollout action plan for DAO growth, including overview and system logic, and contributed reference materials with ideas for strategy extensions. Legal efforts focused on defining sections, paragraphs, and bullet points within legal documents. Aléksa also raised concerns about moderate issues in governance, reviewed proposed strategies with suggestions on risks, and reiterated pending decision signals.
